fields.statement: At f8e3bc8a6 re-ran the Checks: block: go test -trimpath -p 2 -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^(skill-check-roles|skill-check|describe-golden)$' ok; go test ./internal/api -run TestSkillCheck ok (TestSkillCheckRoles and its Definitions, Unused skill refused, Findings gate, Not started, Report subtests pass); ./internal/api -run 'Describe|Help|Schema|Decode|Registry|Operation' ok; go vet ./internal/api clean; describe-golden -update, rhiza ship generate and rhiza render left no diff to the commit's files; make self-check passes in a clean detached worktree. skill-check-roles.txtar, with a fake claude and fake rex, shows: a verifier that writes Evidence and says done passes 3 of 3 gates (session-done, evidence, check); one writing a finding instead fails 'evidence' by name and exits non-zero (ExitCode 1 asserted in TestSkillCheckRoles/Report); a check recording a round with rhiza run findings --check passes 3 of 3; one recording none fails 'findings' by name; --role planner is refused with 'want builder, verifier or check'; git status and .rhiza/log of the current repo are unchanged after every case, and no builder session starts. The diff touches the three named files plus the regenerated describe-golden, docs/reference/cli.md, and the builder's actor record and renders; no TODOs or stubs.
